name: gi-transaction-tax-transition
description: Prepare an evidence-led review of goods imports, local production and the 2026 transaction-tax transition. This is a transition research draft, not a customs declaration or an exhaustive commodity-rate catalogue. This source-cited draft supports preparation of reviewable working papers using the stated periods, evidence requirements and computation examples. Retain source evidence and effective dates; unresolved points and professional review remain explicit. Use the linked official materials when checking a case, and obtain a qualified local review before filing or making a payment. Read the explicit exclusions before applying its calculations to different facts.
